evidence: Modifies SQLite database backend files in src/wallet/sqlite.cpp and src/wallet/sqlite.h.
rationale: Encapsulates manual `sqlite3_stmt` management into an RAII class to reduce boilerplate and prevent resource leaks. While it prepares the wallet SQLite backend for upcoming work like #33034 ('wallet: Store transactions in a separate sqlite table'), it is primarily an internal refactoring with no direct user-facing bug fix or feature.
